Market today: The tech and chip sectors are under significant pressure, with Nvidia's deep plunge signaling a broader "tech wreck." This mood is the real driver, directly impacting your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-86.26%) and MUU (-74.08%) are bleeding heavily in leveraged chip ETFs, amplifying losses. CRWD (+31.16%) is your only strong performer, flagged for trimming. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Nvidia's price action for any signs of stabilization, and monitor for further M&A news in cybersecurity.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged, deep-red tech/chip positions.
plays: Trim CRWD (+31.16%) given its "TRIM" status and sector M&A news.
Review and tighten stops on SOXL and MUU; these leveraged chip ETFs are bleeding heavily.
No new buys today. Tech sentiment is too negative for new long positions.
